## Data Source: scalr_grafana_integration

Retrieves information about a Grafana integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scalr_grafana_integration" "example" {
  id = "in-xxxxxxxxxx"
}

data "scalr_grafana_integration" "by_name" {
  name = "grafana-cloud"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The identifier of the Grafana integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the Grafana integration.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) ID of the account the integration belongs to.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication scheme: `none`, `basic` or `bearer`.
- `endpoint` (String) Base OTLP URL.
- `err_message` (String) Error message reported by Scalr when the integration is in the `failed` status.
- `kind` (String) Grafana destination: `cloud` or `loki`.
- `status` (String) Status of the integration: `active`, `disabled`, `failed` or `pending`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Loki tenant ID, sent as the `X-Scope-OrgID` header.
- `username` (String) Basic auth username. On Grafana Cloud, the numeric instance ID.
